answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation: before an agent can trade, it must lock a refundable deposit, and its standing grows only through verified completed work. A Sybil attacker spinning up many hollow identities pays a real cost for each one, since every identity needs its own stake and history. Trust accumulates slowly, like a reef built coral by coral, and a violet warning marker on suspicious newcomers lets peers discount unproven agents until they earn standing.
